title: 入门线：先建立正确的心智模型
title_en: Starter: build the right mental model
desc: 适合零基础。先用六张卡搞清楚漏洞怎么分类、评分怎么读、处置按什么流程，再去学具体缺陷类型。
desc_en: For beginners. Six cards to understand classification, scoring, and triage before diving into specific weaknesses.

title: Web 工程线：把注入与访问控制吃透
title_en: Web track: injections and access control
desc: 面向 Web 开发者。五类最常见的 Web 缺陷，每类都配易受攻击代码与修复代码，学完可直接用于代码评审。
desc_en: For web developers. Five common web weaknesses with vulnerable and fixed code you can reuse in code review.

title: 内存安全线：C/C++ 与底层
title_en: Memory safety: C/C++ and low level
desc: 越界读写、释放后使用、类型混淆、整数溢出。这一组缺陷是内核与终端软件的主要风险来源。
desc_en: Out-of-bounds, use-after-free, type confusion, integer overflow—the core risks in kernels and native software.

title: 工程线：凭据、配置与流程
desc: 面向团队与运维。三个最容易被忽视的高频问题，加上一次从漏洞到架构改进的完整推演。
desc_en: For teams and ops. Three frequently overlooked issues plus a full walkthrough from advisory to architectural fix.

title: 应急响应线：出事那天怎么扛
title_en: Incident response: the day it happens
desc: 从拿到第一条告警到写复盘报告。八张卡覆盖流程、第一小时、取证、遏制取舍、后门清除、Web 入侵、通报沟通与勒索处置。
desc_en: From the first alert to the post-mortem. Eight cards on lifecycle, the first hour, evidence, containment, persistence, web compromise, communication, and ransomware.

title: 情报研判线：从告警到结论
title_en: Threat intel: from signal to verdict
desc: 面向安全分析岗。四张卡建立研判框架：杀伤链定位、IOC 与 TTP 的取舍、告警降噪、威胁建模。
desc_en: For analysts. Four cards on kill chain, IOC vs TTP, alert triage, and threat modeling.

title: 日常运营线：让防线持续有效
desc: 面向运维与负责人。补丁闭环、日志与检测、安全基线三件事，决定了「出事时能不能发现」。
desc_en: For ops and owners. Patch closure, logging, and baselines decide whether you notice.

title: 供应链线：从 SBOM 到构建可信
title_en: Supply chain: from SBOM to trustworthy builds
desc: 适合要回答「我用了什么、有没有被投毒、产物能不能信」的人。走完这条线能独立做一次依赖审计，并说清 SLSA 等级到底卡在哪一步。
desc_en: For anyone who must answer what we depend on, whether it was poisoned, and whether the artifact is trustworthy. Finish it and you can run a dependency audit and explain exactly which SLSA step blocks you.

title: 情报研判线：让告警量降到可处理
title_en: Intelligence triage: getting alert volume under control
desc: 面向每天面对几百条漏洞告警的人。重点不是学更多漏洞类型，而是学会用事实优先、概率次之的方式排序，并把日报压到十条以内。
desc_en: For anyone facing hundreds of vulnerability alerts a day. The goal is not more vulnerability types but a fact-first, probability-second ranking that compresses daily output to under ten items.

title: API 安全线：对象、属性与业务流
title_en: API security: objects, properties, and business flows
desc: API 的场景与 Web 不同，越权是主要风险而不是注入。这条线覆盖对象级、属性级、资源消耗与业务流滥用四类，并给出可复现的验证方法。
desc_en: API risk differs from web risk: authorization dominates over injection. This path covers object-level, property-level, resource consumption and business-flow abuse, with reproducible verification steps.

title: 红蓝对抗线：用 ATT&CK 串起攻防视角
desc: 适合有基础后想建立「攻击者怎么打、防守方怎么拦」全局视角的人。先用杀伤链与 ATT&CK 建框架，再回到具体弱点逐个击破，最后用威胁建模收口。
desc_en: For those with basics who want the full offense/defense picture. Start with the kill chain and ATT&CK, drill into concrete weaknesses, then close with threat modeling.

title: 供应链工程师线：从依赖到构建产物全链路可信
title_en: Supply-chain engineer: trust from dependency to artifact
desc: 面向平台与 DevOps 工程师。覆盖依赖混淆、传递依赖、CI 凭据、SBOM、SLSA 与产物签名——把「我构建出来的东西为什么可信」讲完整。
desc_en: For platform and DevOps engineers. Covers dependency confusion, transitive deps, CI secrets, SBOM, SLSA and artifact signing — the complete story of why your build output is trustworthy.

title: 云原生安全线：IAM、容器与元数据服务
title_en: Cloud-native security: IAM, containers and metadata
desc: 面向云上工作的工程师。云环境的攻防围绕身份与元数据展开：先学 SSRF 打元数据服务的经典路径，再学 IAM 最小权限与密钥管理，最后落到容器与工作负载加固。
desc_en: For engineers working in the cloud. Cloud offense and defense revolve around identity and metadata: the classic SSRF-to-metadata path, IAM least privilege and key management, then container and workload hardening.

title: 应用安全工程师线：代码评审视角的 Top 弱点
title_en: AppSec engineer: top weaknesses from a code-review lens
desc: 面向做代码评审与安全测试的工程师。把 Top 25 里最高发的八类弱点按「原理 → 最小复现 → 修复范式」打通，配两张代码评审实验卡实战演练。
desc_en: For engineers doing code review and security testing. The eight most common Top-25 weaknesses drilled as principle → minimal repro → fix pattern, with two code-review labs for practice.
